body:
Fee-generating assets under management totaled €195 billion. Net inflows to key funds were €10.9 billion, including €10.3 billion related to Coller Capital’s inclusion.

EQT recorded €41.6 billion in gross inflows in the third quarter, while assets under management totaled €354 billion and fee-generating assets reached €195 billion, giving a snapshot of fundraising and assets tied to fees.

Net inflows to EQT’s key funds were €10.9 billion. Of that amount, €10.3 billion related to Coller Capital’s inclusion.

The reported figures also put fee-generating assets under management at €195 billion.

John Kim John Kim reports on the digital-asset business for TokenPost. Send corrections or tips to info@tokenpost.com.
